'''Fernando José Silva García''' (born 16 May 1977) is a former [[Association football|footballer]] who played as a [[Forward (association football)|forward]].

Born in Spain, he has represented the [[Andorra national football team|Andorra national team]] internationally.

==Early life==
Silva was born in Barcelona, Catalonia to Extremaduran parents and raised in [[Montijo, Spain|Montijo]].<ref name=BD/>
